title: CAS-07542 — The Late Late Show — RTÉ One
text:
Programme: The Late Late Show
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ One
Date broadcast or accessed: 27.03.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Sections 46J(1)(a) and 46J(1)(b) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Short description: This edition of the programme featured a comedian who performed a song. The complaint alleges the performance promoted use of an illegal substance causing harm and undue offence and promoting illegal drug use.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 21.05.2026
